properties.name: Thunag Cloudburst 2025
properties.history: Catastrophic event that triggered major debris flows and flash floods in Seraj valley.

properties.name: Kedarnath Mega Cloudburst
properties.history: Extreme rainfall and glacial lake outburst devastated the Mandakini valley.

properties.name: Samej Flash Flood Event
properties.history: Washed away entire hamlets in Samej village and damaged SJVN infrastructure.

properties.name: Asi Ganga Cloudburst
properties.history: Multiple fatalities and major destruction in the Asi Ganga river basin.

properties.name: Chojh (Manikaran) Cloudburst
properties.history: Sudden flood in a seasonal stream washed away tourism infrastructure and people.

properties.name: Dharampur Bus Stand Flood
properties.history: Intense rain in the Son river catchment inundated the Dharampur market area.

properties.name: Bastadi Cloudburst Disaster
properties.history: Cloudburst in Didihat area caused massive debris flow and fatalities in Bastadi village.

properties.name: Bharmour Flash Flood
properties.history: Washouts on Mani Mahesh route during heavy monsoon rain.

properties.name: Ghat Valley Cloudburst
properties.history: Several shops and bridges were washed away in the Ghat market area.

properties.name: Parwanoo NH Washout
properties.history: Triggered massive landslides on NH-5; multiple sections of the road collapsed.

properties.name: Malana Dam Breach Cloudburst
properties.history: Burst of Malana Dam-II following a cloudburst, causing heavy damage downstream.

properties.name: Sambhal (Pandoh) Cloudburst
properties.history: Flash flood in a seasonal stream swept away several houses and vehicles near Pandoh.

properties.name: Devprayag Cloudburst
properties.history: Multiple buildings including a vocational training center were destroyed.

properties.name: Ramgarh Debris Flow
properties.history: Unexpected late monsoon cloudburst caused massive damage in the fruit-growing belt of Ramgarh.

properties.name: Jhalman Nallah Flood
properties.history: Cloudburst in the upper reaches of Jhalman nallah caused flash floods in the Chenab valley.

properties.name: Brahamganga Manikaran Cloudburst
properties.history: Flash flood in Brahamganga stream near Manikaran washed away several people.

properties.name: Raipur Sarkhet Cloudburst
properties.history: Extreme rainfall in Raipur area caused flash floods in Song river and debris flows in Sarkhet village.

properties.name: Parashar Lake Area Cloudburst
properties.history: Sudden heavy rain caused damage to road infrastructure leading to Parashar lake.

properties.name: Mori Arakot Disaster
properties.history: Multiple cloudbursts in Mori tehsil caused massive destruction in several villages and multiple fatalities.

properties.name: Jhakhri Power House Area
properties.history: Intense rain triggered debris flows near the Nathpa Jhakri project site.

properties.name: Tharali Pindar Valley
properties.history: Pindar river overflowed its banks due to a cloudburst in the upper reaches, damaging Tharali market.

properties.name: Upper Bhagsu Flash Flood
properties.history: Cloudburst in Dhauladhar range caused a massive surge in the Bhagsu stream, damaging luxury cars and shops.

properties.name: Dharchula Border Cloudburst
properties.history: Cloudburst in Nepal-India border area caused flash floods in Kali river and local streams.

properties.name: Salooni Sector Cloudburst
properties.history: Sudden heavy rain in Salooni area caused damage to agriculture and local bridges.

properties.name: Augustmuni Flash Flood
properties.history: Cloudburst in the Mandakini catchment caused a sudden rise in water levels, affecting riverside markets.

properties.name: Kandaghat Railway Area
properties.history: Heavy rain triggered landslides and debris flow near the Kalka-Shimla heritage line.

properties.name: Ghansali Balganga Flood
properties.history: Cloudburst in Balganga valley caused widespread destruction of property and livestock.

properties.name: Sangla Orchard Flash Flood
properties.history: Unexpected heavy rainfall caused damage to apple orchards and link roads in Sangla valley.

properties.name: Kapkot Saryu Valley
properties.history: Local cloudburst triggered sudden floods in small tributaries of Saryu river.

properties.name: Billing Nallah Keylong
properties.history: Flash flood in Billing nallah temporarily blocked the Manali-Leh highway.

properties.name: Bhikiyasain Ramganga Surge
properties.history: Ramganga river levels rose sharply following intense rain in the upper catchment.

properties.name: Tandi Bridge Flash Flood
properties.history: Sudden flood in seasonal khad near Tandi caused damage to under-construction bridge.

properties.name: Lambagarh Alaknanda Surge
properties.history: Cloudburst over Lambagarh caused a debris flow that temporarily dammed the Alaknanda river.

properties.name: Beas Upper Valley Cloudburst
properties.history: Extreme rain in the Solang valley area triggered record water levels in the Beas river.

properties.name: Haldwani Gaula Catchment
properties.history: Cloudburst in the Gaula river catchment caused record-breaking discharge and damage to barrages.

properties.name: Kotkhai Apple Belt Rain
properties.history: Heavy cloudburst rain caused erosion and landslide in the Kotkhai apple growing region.

properties.name: Khirsu Forest Zone Rain
properties.history: Intense local rain triggered small-scale debris flows in the Khirsu forest area.

properties.name: Palampur Neugal Surge
properties.history: Neugal stream in Palampur witnessed a sudden surge following heavy rain in the Dhauladhars.

properties.name: Gangotri Highway Sector
properties.history: Heavy local rain caused rockfalls and temporary closure of the Gangotri National Highway.

properties.name: Janjehli Valley Flood
properties.history: Local streams in Janjehli valley overflowed, damaging village paths and retaining walls.

properties.name: Dharampur Cloudburst
properties.history: August 2015: Intense cloudburst led to sudden flooding in Dharampur town. The bus stand was completely submerged, and several buses were washed away. Significant damage to property and local infrastructure.
properties.remarks: Highlighted the vulnerability of towns built near mountain streams.

properties.name: Manikaran Cloudburst
properties.history: July 6, 2022: Cloudburst in Chojh village near Manikaran. Several people were washed away as the Parvati river swelled suddenly. Multiple camping sites and bridges were destroyed.
properties.remarks: Affected the busy tourism circuit of Parvati Valley.

properties.name: Samej Massive Cloudburst
properties.history: August 1, 2024: One of the worst cloudbursts in HP. Wiped out whole hamlets in Samej, Rampur. Over 30 people missing. Massive debris flow downstream.
properties.remarks: Caused catastrophic damage to both life and energy infrastructure (Malana II project).

properties.name: Thathri Cloudburst
properties.history: August 1, 2024: Occurred simultaneously with Samej. High intensity rain caused small streams to turn into raging torrents of mud and boulders.

properties.name: Bagipul Cloudburst
properties.history: July 31, 2024: Sudden heavy rain in Nirmand area. Bagipul market saw massive debris inflow. Houses and shops were washed away.
properties.remarks: Critical road connectivity to Anni and Nirmand cut off.

properties.name: Jahalman Cloudburst
properties.history: July 2021: Cloudburst in Jahalman nallah in Lahaul valley. Caused blockage of Chandrabhaga river and damage to agriculture land.
properties.remarks: Rare high-intensity event in cold desert region.
